selection.vegetated: closest vegetated mark to node median vegetated site_m; tie -> lower site_m
selection.thalassia: closest Thalassia-positive mark to node median vegetated site_m; tie -> lower site_m

interpretation: Bare-control geography remains feasible when the vegetated deployment meter mark is selected independently of mapped meadow-edge distance. The Thalassia-specific representative-placement gate passes at the frozen minimum in Old Tampa Bay (3 nodes), so field qualification rather than edge-nearest sensor placement must determine the final counterfactual subset.
decision: Freeze representative sensor placement independently of mapped edge distance. For the primary Thalassia persistence cohort, choose the Thalassia-positive meter mark closest to the median recent vegetated site_m; then search for a bare control within 100 m of that preselected deployment mark.
claim_boundary: No future biological response was used.
Mapped edge distance is not used to choose the vegetated sensor position.
GIS feasibility does not replace field depth/forcing/substrate/wake qualification.
Do not switch to an edge-nearest meter mark to rescue a field-control failure.
